purpose: Groups related content and actions on a distinct surface, e.g. a plan option, an order summary, or a settings section.

variants.name: selectable
variants.usage: One-of-many choice (e.g. subscription plans); selection state must not rely on color alone.

variants.name: summary
variants.usage: Read-only recap of user input before a final commit (checkout review, upgrade review).

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading; rendered as a section heading for AT navigation.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selection state for the selectable variant.

accessibility.requirement: Card title renders as a real heading element in the document outline.
Selectable cards expose selection via a real input (radio), not just styling.

constraints.rule: title is mandatory; anonymous surfaces are not allowed.
Cards must not nest more than one level deep.
